Question 22(b) [3 marks]: Outline how the minimum employment standards protect employees in Australia. Use examples in your answer.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 3):
3 marks: Sketches in general terms how minimum employment standards protect employees using examples
2 marks: Sketches in general terms how minimum employment standards protect employees and may provide example(s)
1 marks: Makes a relevant statement about minimum employment standards

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Minimum employment standards include eleven legally mandated standards that provide basic protections for all employees. The minimum standards outline basic employee rights in the workplace, regardless of the type of employment contract. For example, all full-time workers are provided with the right to four weeks annual leave and a paid day off on public holidays.



WHAT THE REAL MARKERS SAID ABOUT THIS QUESTION:
Better responses: use specific and relevant examples from the Australian national minimum employment standards (a,b)
Better responses: provide details on how human resource processes and strategies can benefit a business (b,c)
Better responses: provide accurate and detailed implications of carrying out an induction program for employees (c).
To improve: using relevant examples to support human resource theory (a,b,c)
To improve: ensuring that responses specifically address the relevant area of the syllabus
To improve: providing clear responses that demonstrate knowledge of key human resource influences, processes and management strategies relevant to the question (a,b,c).
